title: Freeze V4 v1 contracts and stable CLI identities
goal: Freeze strict JSON Schemas, stable CLI commands, exit categories, architecture capability contracts and the genesis acceptance record before production V4 Stage or state implementation begins.
acceptanceCriteria: Strict schemas exist for plugin, profile, module, Stage result, state, Plan, plan-set, capability matrix, rule execution plan, CLI contract and genesis acceptance record.
Profiles cannot declare arbitrary commands or environment mutation and modules cannot request TargetRoot or PackageRoot writes.

The stable v1 CLI contract names independent Stage execution, contract validation, reset Preview/Apply, Plan validation and deterministic plan-set composition with stable exit categories 0 and 10 through 19.
Blocking architecture claims require layered evidence, positive minimum matches and clean, violating and missing-input fixtures.
The genesis record cannot be accepted by the candidate V4 host and binds the seed, package/contracts, deterministic tests and recovery evidence.
A deterministic manifest hash-binds every frozen contract and positive/negative schema tests pass.
Current V3 validation remains green and no workflow, ruleset, V3/V3_ifx authority or remote state changes.
